datasets.purpose: FreeCAD milling project with left/right layout jobs, STEP exports, split NC files and a setup sheet
datasets.pairing: Associated by upstream job names and CAM document contents; geometric registration and finished-part equivalence are not verified.

datasets.purpose: Simulation examples with explicit stock/tool definitions; multiple NC files and a generated surface path
datasets.pairing: CAMotics project files explicitly reference the bundled programs or generator; no STEP model supplied.

datasets.purpose: LinuxCNC dialect examples: incremental polar canned drilling, tool changes with compensation, and probing loops
datasets.pairing: Standalone language examples; no part-model pairing claimed.

datasets.purpose: Synthetic SM-101 sensor-mount plate with STEP, drawing, feature/tool metadata and Fusion-posted Haas NC
datasets.pairing: SM-101 association documented by upstream paths and feature metadata; not an independently verified shop job.

datasets.purpose: CNC-milled hardware enclosure (base, cap, buttons) across Rev 0.2–0.4 with STEP models, multi-op and two-sided NC programs, plus PCB isolation/drilling/cutout NC
datasets.pairing: Rev 0.2 and Rev 0.3 pair kroneum.step with cnc/*.nc in the same revision folder; Rev 0.4 provides 16 split base/top/chamfer/cutout NC programs without a co-located Rev 0.4 STEP export.

datasets.purpose: Fusion-generated STEP fixtures (ops_block, ops_2d, ops_3d, ops_engrave, lego_4x2_01) paired with Masso-posted NC programs across 2D/3D/thread/chamfer/engrave strategies, plus GRBL/Masso/Centroid post-processor golden NC files
datasets.pairing: Explicitly paired by upstream scripts/fusion/ automation and fixtures/step/README.md; Fusion STEP exports use cm (or inch for lego_4x2_01.step) while posted NC programs use G21 mm.

datasets.purpose: Machined electric-longboard truck hanger, motor mounts, belt cap and battery holder with STEP models and imperial (G20) PathPilot/Mach3 TAP programs
datasets.pairing: Associated by component names (CustomHangerV2, MotorMountLeft/Right, Belt Cap); MotorMount STEP exports are V5 while TAP programs are V1/v2.

datasets.purpose: Quadruped robot actuator cycloidal disk STEP model paired with Fusion 360 drilling and 2D adaptive/contour NC programs
datasets.pairing: Co-located under Actuator/Mechanics/Cycloidal Drive/; geometric registration and stock origin are not independently verified.

datasets.purpose: Large-format CNC structural parts with Y ballscrew motor-support STEP and NC/TAP programs featuring G18 ZX-plane lead-in arcs, Fanuc-style :1248 program headers and custom M1010 macro calls
datasets.pairing: Co-located in Milling Files/; NC files cover multiple plate thicknesses (19 mm, 30 mm) and spindle support operations rather than a single one-to-one STEP export.

datasets.purpose: Curated FreeCAD Path (linuxcnc_post) and SolidCAM/CAMWorks benchmark tasks with paired STEP models, FreeCAD CAM documents, tool tables, fixture/vise check geometry, dogbone slots, holding tags and two-sided (G54/G55) programs
datasets.pairing: Each task folder pairs init_file/*.step (and optional fixture.step or CSV tool/hole tables) with ground_truth/*.FCStd and ground_truth/*.nc as specified in task-*.json.

datasets.purpose: OpenCASCADE CAM test models (handle.step, trigger.step), 3D surface NGC program using numbered parameters (#101) and (MSG, ...), plus arc/spiral NGC test inputs
